message:
2 string literals reach the DOM through a name the template binds:
      libs/components/widget/src/widget.html:33: interpolation reads `m` → "Delete "
      libs/components/widget/src/widget.html:33: interpolation reads `m` → " rows"
description: Words written around an interpolation in an attribute an `<ng-template>` hands its directive, which sets the input to the string the interpolation makes (measured: drawn "Delete 0 rows"). A name stands for what binds it, and an interpolation's value is its words as much as its expressions: a read of the expressions alone passed it, and the refusal counts two, the words on either side.
